title: Tip integrator params
description: Controls how TipCandidates from all active tip modes are cross-validated into a single TipIdentificationResult.

consensus_window_px.description: Candidates from different modes within this many pixels are considered to agree and vote for the same location.

min_modes_for_consensus.description: Minimum number of distinct modes that must agree on a location to produce a confident result. 1 = any single mode is sufficient.
